_meta.title: Migrant rights in national migration policy (SDG 10.7.2, Domain 1)
_meta.what: Governments' own answers to the UN Inquiry on migration policy, scored 1-4. value = Domain 1 "Migrant rights" (e.g. equal access to services and social protection for migrants regardless of status, equal pay, and protection from discrimination): 1 = Requires further progress, 2 = Partially meets, 3 = Meets, 4 = Fully meets. The other five domains and the all-domain score are included. Latest year with a Domain 1 score per country; every year is in by_year. Null = the source row is NaN (no response that round).
_meta.source: UN DESA / IOM, SDG indicator 10.7.2, UN SDG Global Database (series SG_CPA_MIGRS)
_meta.licence: No dataset-specific licence found. UNdata terms: data "may be copied freely, duplicated and further distributed provided that UNdata is cited".
_meta.citation: United Nations Statistics Division, SDG Global Database, series SG_CPA_MIGRS (indicator 10.7.2), custodians UN DESA and IOM (accessed 2026-10-21).
_meta.caveat: Self-reported by governments; a high score means the government says its policies meet the criteria, not that migrants experience no discrimination.
_meta.live: Yes: unstats.un.org/sdgapi returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin for the site origin.
